address: C4, Phase 2, Lizhiwan Scenic Area, Huangsha Avenue, Liwan, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: This is not only a noodle shop, but also a factory that makes bouncy noodles for various restaurants in Guangzhou and Hong Kong. These famous strands made with duck eggs are dried outside the shop, which is nestled in a picturesque park. Dried plaice toasted on charcoal is added to the broth alongside pork backbones and dried shrimp for depth. Plump and brimming with filling, the flying fish roe wontons have umami-laden beads that pop in the mouth....
